A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species''' resided in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="No Redeeming Value" /> around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "No Redeeming Value" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Considered by some to be primitive, they treated [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]] created by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] director [[Leero]]&mdash;which were generally considered tasteless in the wider [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]&mdash;as [[Deity/Legends|divine]] messages.<ref name="No Redeeming Value" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] tasked a companion with helping Leero facilitate sales of their works. The companion discovered the [[Species/Legends|species]] and their veneration of Leero's holodramas, and subsequently the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] happily traded their wealth for [[Hologram disc/Legends|discs]] containing those works.<ref name="No Redeeming Value" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The species was mentioned in an Underworld Trading Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="No Redeeming Value" />
